title: Sing It Round Again And You Are Flat
summary: Tune every chord of I vi ii V pure against the one before and the tonic comes back a syntonic comma flat, every time round. Step through it, then watch tempering close the loop.

sources.title: Barbour, Tuning and Temperament: A Historical Survey
Benson, Music: A Mathematical Offering, chapter 5 (scales and temperaments)
Helmholtz, On the Sensations of Tone, appendix XX (tempered intervals)
